53838-virginia-of-virginia-a-story.creator: Amélie Rives
53838-virginia-of-virginia-a-story.description: A book by Amélie Rives. At the moment he first saw the figure alluded to, the owner of the British accent and the “loose pants” was shivering in spite of the top-coat turned up about his ears and the soft hat pulled down to meet it.

arxiv-2208-09008.title: SDSS-IV MaNGA: the chemical co-evolution of gas and stars in spiral galaxies 2022 SDSS-IV MaNGA: the chemical co-evolution of gas and stars in spiral galaxies – A3
arxiv-2208-09008.creator: Michael J. Greener, Alfonso Aragón-Salamanca, Michael Merrifield, Thomas Peterken, Elizaveta Sazonova, Roan Haggar, Dmitry Bizyaev, Joel R. Brownstein, Richard R. Lane, and Kaike Pan
arxiv-2208-09008.description: Abstract We investigate archaeologically how the metallicity in both stellar and gaseous components of spiral galaxies of differing masses evolve with time, using data from the SDSS-IV MaNGA survey. For the stellar component, we can measure this evolution directly by decomposing the galaxy absorption-line spectra into populations of different ages and determining their metallicities.

arxiv-2211-04867.title: Trackerless freehand ultrasound with sequence modelling and auxiliary transformation over past and future frames
arxiv-2211-04867.creator: Qi Li, Ziyi Shen, Qian Li, Dean C Barratt, Thomas Dowrick, Matthew J Clarkson, Tom Vercauteren, Yipeng Hu
arxiv-2211-04867.description: Abstract Three-dimensional (3D) freehand ultrasound (US) reconstruction without a tracker can be advantageous over its two-dimensional or tracked counterparts in many clinical applications. In this paper, we propose to estimate 3D spatial transformation between US frames from both past and future 2D images, using feed-forward and recurrent neural networks (RNNs).

arxiv-2303-00342.title: Reheating consistency condition on the classically conformal U ​ ( 1 ) B − L U(1)_{B-L} Higgs inflation model
arxiv-2303-00342.creator: Shinsuke Kawai, Nobuchika Okada
arxiv-2303-00342.description: Abstract We revisit a cosmological scenario based on the classically conformal U ​ ( 1 ) B − L U(1)_{B-L} -extension of the Standard Model. Our focus is on the mechanism of reheating after inflation and the constraints on the model parameters.

arxiv-2405-08130.title: Collisions of Burgers Bores with Nonlinear Waves
arxiv-2405-08130.creator: A. Dombret, D.D. Holm, R. Hu, O.D. Street, H. Wang (1) Physics, École Normale Supérieure, (2) Mathematics, Imperial College London
arxiv-2405-08130.description: Abstract This paper treats nonlinear wave-current interactions in their simplest form – as an overtaking collision. In one spatial dimension, the paper investigates the collision interaction formulated as an initial value problem of a Burgers bore overtaking solutions of two types of nonlinear wave equations – Korteweg–de Vries (KdV) and nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS).

arxiv-2407-05481.title: Quantum criticality in coupled hybrid metal-semiconductor islands
arxiv-2407-05481.creator: D. B. Karki
arxiv-2407-05481.description: Abstract We show that the combined effects of dynamical Coulomb blockade and integer quantum Hall effect in a coupled hybrid metal-semiconductor setup provide a pathway for realizing resonant tunneling in Luttinger liquids. This hybrid setup can be brought to the quantum critical regime by varying gate voltages and contact resistances.

arxiv-2408-08236.title: Derivatives on Graphs for the Positive Calculus of Relations with Transitive Closure
arxiv-2408-08236.creator: Yoshiki Nakamura ORCID:0000-0003-4106-0408
arxiv-2408-08236.description: Abstract . We prove that the equational theory of the positive calculus of relations with transitive closure (PCoR*) is EXPSPACE-complete. Here, PCoR* terms consist of the following standard operators on binary relations: identity, empty, universality, union, intersection, composition, converse, and reflexive transitive closure (so, PCoR* terms subsume Kleene algebra and allegory terms as fragments).

arxiv-2409-05818.title: Non-local resources for error correction in quantum LDPC codes
arxiv-2409-05818.creator: Omprakash Chandra, Gopikrishnan Muraleedharan, Gavin K. Brennen
arxiv-2409-05818.description: Abstract Quantum low density parity check (qLDPC) codes are an attractive alternative to the surface code due to their relatively high code rate and distance. However, unlike the surface code which has simple, geometrically local, stabilizer checks, high performing qLDPC codes have non-local stabilizers that are challenging to measure.

arxiv-2410-10757.title: The impact of nonlocal coupling on deterministic and stochastic wavefront propagation in an ensemble of bistable oscillators Journal: Physics Letters A
arxiv-2410-10757.creator: Vladimir V. Semenov
arxiv-2410-10757.description: Abstract Based on methods of numerical simulation, the constructive role of nonlocal coupling is demonstrated in the context of wavefront propagation observed in an ensemble of overdamped bistable oscillators. Firstly, it is shown that the wavefront propagation can be controlled, i.e. accelerated or slowed down, by varying the strength and radius of nonlocal interactions.

arxiv-2506-01302.title: Recent Developments in GNNs for Drug Discovery
arxiv-2506-01302.creator: Zhengyu Fang, Xiaoge Zhang, Anyin Zhao, Xiao Li, Huiyuan Chen, Jing Li
arxiv-2506-01302.description: Abstract In this paper, we review recent developments and the role of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) in computational drug discovery, including molecule generation, molecular property prediction, and drug-drug interaction prediction. By summarizing the most recent developments in this area, we underscore the capabilities of GNNs to comprehend intricate molecular patterns, while exploring both their current and prospective applications.

arxiv-2512-05073.title: David vs. Goliath: Can Small Models Win Big with Agentic AI in Hardware Design?
arxiv-2512-05073.creator: Shashwat Shankar 1 * , Subhranshu Pandey 1 * , Innocent Dengkhw Mochahari 1 , Bhabesh Mali 1 , Animesh Basak Chowdhury 2 , Sukanta Bhattacharjee 1 , Chandan Karfa 1
arxiv-2512-05073.description: Abstract . LLM ( LLM ) inference demands massive compute and energy, making domain-specific tasks expensive and unsustainable. As foundation models keep scaling, we ask: Is bigger always better for hardware design? Our work tests this by evaluating \Acp SLM coupled with a curated agentic AI framework on NVIDIA’s CVDP ( CVDP ) benchmark.

arxiv-2601-08129.title: Emergent Coordination in Multi-Agent Systems via Pressure Fields and Temporal Decay
arxiv-2601-08129.creator: Roland R. Rodriguez, Jr
arxiv-2601-08129.description: Abstract Current multi-agent large language model (LLM) frameworks rely on explicit orchestration patterns borrowed from human organizational structures: planners delegate to executors, managers coordinate workers, and hierarchical control flow governs agent interactions. These approaches suffer from coordination overhead that scales poorly with agent count and task complexity.

pmc-11727899.title: Evaluation of Pedicle Screw Position on Computerized Tomography Using Three-Dimensional Reconstruction Software
pmc-11727899.creator: Jiwon Park, Jin S Yeom, Yeonho Kim, Yoonjoong Hwang, Namkug Kim, Sang-Min Park, Vassilios S Nikolaou
pmc-11727899.description: Background and Objectives: Recent advances in intraoperative navigation systems have improved the accuracy of pedicle screw placement in spine surgery. However, many hospitals have limited access to these advanced technologies due to resource constraints. In such settings, postoperative computed tomography (CT) evaluation remains crucial for assessing screw placement and related potential complications.

pmc-12522398.creator: Bin Hong, Hyesung Lee, Kyungyeon Jung, Sang Youl Rhee, Dong Keon Yon, Ju-Young Shin
pmc-12522398.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the use of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT-2) inhibitors and risk of autoimmune rheumatic diseases in adults with type 2 diabetes.DesignRetrospective cohort study.SettingNationwide healthcare database in South Korea, 2012-22.Participants2 032 157 adults aged ≥18 years with type 2 diabetes: 552 065 initiated SGLT-2 inhibitors and 1 480 092 initiated sulfonylureas.

pmc-13116019.title: Debate: Young people are living in unprecedented times – too much chaos or too little resilience?: No Pain, No Gain? Why articulating distress marks youth resilience
pmc-13116019.creator: Levi van Dam
pmc-13116019.description: Rising levels of anxiety and depression among children and adolescents are increasingly cited as evidence that today's youth are growing up in a world of unprecedented chaos and diminishing resilience. Yet, this interpretation rests on a fragile assumption: that greater expression of distress necessarily signals weaker coping. In this debate article, we argue the opposite.

pmc-13240628.title: Management of infected periprosthetic fracture of hip and knee: a systematic review of the literature
pmc-13240628.creator: Luigi Zagra, Mattia Alessio-Mazzola, Giulia D’Andrea, Giacomo Placella, Francesco Anzano, Vincenzo Salini
pmc-13240628.description: PurposeThe coexistence of periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) and periprosthetic fracture (PPFx) is one of the most challenging complications after total hip arthroplasty (THA) and total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Evidence regarding the management and outcomes of concomitant PJI and PPFx remains limited.
